description: Check a mail domain's DNS records now, instead of waiting for the next check. It asks DNS for each record and records what it finds. Right records move a pending domain to `active`. A record DNS says is missing or wrong moves an active domain to `failing`, which starts its grace period (`graceEndsAt`). A lookup that gets no answer changes nothing. The answer is the domain as list_mail_domains describes it.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: check_mail_domain
title: Check a mail domain
